_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands have a combined fleet of 64 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 150,005 berths as of December 31, 2022'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'Demand for cruises is affected by international, national, and local economic conditions' (its own FY2022 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands have a combined fleet of 64 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 150,005 berths as of December 31, 2022'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'Demand for cruises is affected by international, national, and local economic conditions' (its own FY2022 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.27x; +78% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.41; conservative 2yr +96%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY13-FY19, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +59.7%/yr (Q2 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 median

BULL.desc: EPS +59.7%/yr (FY13-FY19 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +59.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY13-FY19); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2023-07-28) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.27x (35.5% downside to Bear $70 / +134.0% upside to Bull $254) | Adj composite 2.90 vs market 1.49: gap +1.41 [UNDERVALUED] | +78% above the EPP floor $61 (10x FY23E $6.10) | Conservative 2-yr case: +95.7% total (+47.8%/yr) | At 17.8x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $144 sits at or below the BASE case; Net Yields n/r in Q2 2023, forward net revenue +61.3% (no FY23 guide in numbers, Q2 2023 revenues); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
